laws.name: Maryland Paid Family and Medical Leave (Time to Care Act)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and military-related leave. Funded through employer and employee contributions.

laws.name: Maryland Healthy Working Families Act (Paid Sick and Safe Leave)
laws.description: Provides paid sick and safe leave for medical needs, family caregiving, and issues related to domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking.

laws.name: Maryland School Conference and Activity Leave
laws.description: Allows employees of certain employers to take leave to attend school conferences or classroom activities for their children.

laws.name: Maryland State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Maryland state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Maryland State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Maryland state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
